lines.text: Everything's better with fresh ketchup. The more the better.
What would you like me to draw for you, Master?
With this, we can fix just about anything.
Will you be having the usual?
Manners make the maid.
Let's have some fun when Ade isn't looking!
What are you up to, Master? We can hang out if you don't have anyone to spend time with.
If you have nothing to do right now, how about we go on an adventure together? Let's find somewhere where we can really make some paper planes fly.
A real maid can fold 50 napkins at a time. If you're incapable of that, then you can't call yourself a professional.
At the Maid Cafe, we draw all sorts of fun things on omelet rice and hold napkin-folding competitions. You should come visit sometime.
This here is Cocorella. She does all sorts of things, but she mainly functions as an umbrella. She's got a bit of a temper, so you gotta treat her with respect.
Cocoa, the Maid Leader, at your service.
The path to becoming a professional maid is long and trying.
Master, did you see that? I'm getting stronger!
I wonder how powerful Cocorella plans on becoming...
Wow...
Soda will be jealous if she sees this. I'll give it to Cocorella for safekeeping.
Wow... How did you know I like this?
You can always find me at the cafe, Master.
I can't remember the last time I had so much fun with someone.
Master, I like you just as much as Ade and Soda.
Someone call for a maid?
I'm back, Master... Oh wait, not this one.
Yes sir.
Cocoa, peacekeeper of the world.
Cocorella, activate combat mode.
A professional maid always protects her master.
Time to teach them some manners.
Fast reload.
Whew... humph!
Let's go, Cocorella.
The time is now!
A maid always knows how to wrap things up.
Attention, customers! The time is now!
I got it!
Hohoho!
Perfect.
Jeez!
Uh.
Ow!
I failed to protect you, Master...
For a professional maid, this is a piece of pudding.
